explanation: The Credit Agreement §7.11 sets min DSCR 1.25 on trailing twelve months to 2026-06-30, with numerator base Consolidated EBITDA minus unfinanced capex and cash taxes, denominator scheduled principal plus cash interest. Our calculation on boarded terms (no addbacks) yields DSCR 1.12 fail (calc_id d70761bd-d734-4a3a-9105-9686efe1f526). Amendment No. 2 effective 2026-04-01 permits addback of restructuring charges capped at $500,000 (Amd 2 §3). Financials Q2 2026 show restructuring charges $620,000 (Fin Q2 2026 §2). Addback capped at 500k could not be applied due to data mismatch.
confidence_basis: The boarded terms do not include any addbacks, producing DSCR 1.12 fail; the approved amendment effective 2026-04-01 allows addback of restructuring charges capped at 500000, but the borrower's financials list 620000 restructuring charges, above the cap; trying to apply the capped 500000 addback failed due to mismatched figure.

claims.text: Minimum DSCR is 1.25 based on trailing four quarters to June 30, 2026, with numerator base Consolidated EBITDA minus unfinanced capex and cash taxes, denominator scheduled principal plus cash interest.
claims.quote: (a) Minimum Ratio. The Borrower shall not permit the Debt Service Coverage Ratio, tested as of the last day of each fiscal quarter on a trailing four-quarter basis, to be less than 1.25 to 1.00.

claims.text: Debt Service means scheduled principal plus cash interest paid during the period.
claims.quote: "Debt Service" means, for any period, the sum of (i) scheduled principal payments on Indebtedness and (ii) cash interest paid on Indebtedness, in each case during that period.

claims.text: Debt Service Coverage Ratio means Consolidated EBITDA plus add-backs permitted by Section 7.11, minus unfinanced capex and cash taxes, divided by Debt Service.
claims.quote: "Debt Service Coverage Ratio" means, for any period, the ratio of (i) Consolidated EBITDA for that period, plus any add-back permitted by Section 7.11, minus Unfinanced Capital Expenditures and cash taxes paid during that period, to (ii) Debt Service for that period.

claims.text: Amendment No. 2 effective April 1, 2026 permits addback of restructuring charges up to $500,000 for any test period.
claims.quote: (a) Section 7.11(b) of the Credit Agreement is amended so that, in addition to any add-back already permitted there, the Borrower may add back restructuring charges, to the extent deducted in determining net income, in an aggregate amount not to exceed $500,000 for any test period.

claims.text: Financials Q2 2026 report restructuring charges as $620,000, exceeding the $500,000 cap.
